layman_headline: Market fear is elevated and no swing candidate offers a convincing risk/reward — staying on the sidelines.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a 'Fear' state at 28/100 and has been trending worse all week. Bitcoin is down about 1.5% over 7 days, and most altcoins are down even more. The coins on our watchlist either have bearish chart structures, are already extended after big moves, or lack enough data to analyze properly. None of them present the kind of clear, high-conviction setup we need to risk capital in this environment.
layman_action: Do nothing right now. Keep cash ready. Wait for either the fear to intensify into extreme territory (potential snapback opportunity) or for a clear technical reversal pattern to form on a quality asset.
expert_reasoning: Fear & Greed at 28 with a worsening trend (week avg 27.6) signals persistent risk-off sentiment but is not yet at the extreme levels (≤25) where sharp reversals tend to occur. BTC dominance at 56.4% is unfavorable for altcoin positions. Among candidates: BEAT has conflicting signals (RSI 58 despite -34% 7d drop, suggesting data inconsistency); UB is overextended +42% with no chart data; AAVE has neutral RSI but a downtrend with support 37% away — terrible risk/reward; WLD has a decent 2.4x R/R but bearish structure below all MAs; 币安人生 has a -0.95 chart bias and 0.40x R/R — the worst setup here; FET has the most interesting RSI at 37 (approaching oversold, our most reliable signal) but the bearish chart structure and distant support make the stop-loss undefined. Per my validated rules, with worsening fear and no clear high-conviction setup, HOLD is the disciplined call.

market_context: Crypto markets are in a fear-driven consolidation with BTC at $63.7K and dominance at 56.4%, squeezing altcoins. Macro headwinds from yen intervention fears and regulatory uncertainty are keeping sentiment suppressed.
context_banner: Fear is elevated but not extreme — no high-conviction swing setups exist right now, so capital preservation is the priority.
